thread:
Ivy (sales-eng): POC kickoff with HealthLayer tomorrow. High priority: no static keys, SSO + SCIM provisioning from their AD, ephemeral CI service accounts, and strong guidance if they bring sample PHI. Also they asked whether Dedicated on-prem makes sense for the pilot or go hosted then migrate.
Diego (infra): For SCIM we support group membership sync from AD; map groups -> roles. We can also accept just a SCIM invite POST if they prefer to script provisioning. To enforce no static keys set `disable_static_keys` at the workspace level.
Anya (security): If PHI is in scope we should push Private (VPC/on-prem) right away and require customer-managed KMS. Hosted is okay for synthetic/test data only. We'll include a minimal role matrix and a checklist for least-privilege.
Liam (solutions): For Dedicated on-prem we need: GPU SKU, expected concurrency, avg token length, whether they will upload private models, and desired retention for logs/metrics. Short trial possible (48-72h stress window) but requires infra coordination.
Priya (compliance): They'll need SOC2 docs, encryption at rest details, KMS/HSM certs, and an agreement about data residency. I'll prepare a short packet to attach to the questionnaire reply.
Ivy (sales-eng): Can someone paste a minimal invite/SCIM payload we can send their automation team that enforces SSO-only and gives least-priv svc role for CI?
Diego (infra): Minimal invite JSON (SCIM-friendly). This creates a time-limited svc account with only `svc-inference` and no billing permissions:
```json
{
  "email": "ci-bot@healthlayer.com",
  "display_name": "HealthLayer POC CI",
  "roles": ["svc-inference"],
  "scim_group": "healthlayer-poc-ci",
  "disable_static_keys": true,
  "expires_at": "2026-04-30T23:59:59Z"
}
```
Anya (security): Add to questionnaire: require SAML encrypted assertions, IdP metadata (x509 cert), `groups` claim for mapping, and SCIM bulk sync details. Also recommend restricting ephemeral token minting to their CI IP ranges.
Ivy (sales-eng): Can we provide an example CLI curl for minting ephemeral tokens so their CI can integrate?
Diego (infra): CLI example to mint ephemeral token (1h TTL), response returns token:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/workspaces/healthlayer/ephemeral_tokens" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"role":"svc-inference","ttl_seconds":3600,"allowed_ips":["35.226.0.0/16"]}'
```
Priya (compliance): For KMS: if they want customer-managed keys on Private we need the key ARN (cloud) or HSM cert (on-prem) and a short policy statement allowing Redwood service principals to use the key for encryption. I'll include a template policy.
Liam (solutions): On cost: if they expect >100 rps sustained or large token sizes (1k+ tokens/request) Dedicated is better. For a short stress test we can spin a 48h reserved pool; otherwise hosting + credits is quicker.
Anya (security): Least-privilege role matrix (high level):
- svc-inference: mint ephemeral tokens, call inference, no model uploads
- model-uploader: upload/private models (rare, opt-in)
- billing-view: invoices/usage only (no inference control)
- viewer/auditor: read-only logs/metrics
Only the POC owner gets workspace-admin.
Ivy (sales-eng): Customer asked about auto-provision via their AD. Can SCIM create service accounts from group membership?
Diego (infra): Yes. If their IdP creates a group `healthlayer-poc-ci` and we map that group to `svc-inference`, members become svc accounts. We'll send the SCIM mapping example.
Priya (compliance): Also note: if they later move to Private with peering we need their CIDR ranges and DNS plan. Recommend documenting now so the infra team can pre-approve peering.
onboard-bot: Onboarding link created: https://console.redwood.ai/onboard/healthlayer (expires in 6 days) :link:
Ivy (sales-eng): Action items: Diego - paste SCIM endpoint + mapping example and the invite JSON (done); Anya/Priya - draft questionnaire reply (PHI/KMS/residency); Liam - prepare Dedicated short-trial options and list of required capacity fields. I'll send the invite JSON to their automation lead and loop back. :white_check_mark:
